name: DivingHQ
subtitle: Diving meets, scores & results
shortDescription: Manage diving meets, judge dives and follow live scores on your phone or tablet.
promotionalText: Bring your diving meet together: event management, poolside judging, live results and notifications, with layouts for phones and tablets.
description:
DivingHQ brings diving competitions together on your phone or tablet. DivingHQ is for people aged 13 and older. Organisers, judges, referees, coaches, divers and spectators can use the tools relevant to their role.

ORGANISE YOUR MEET
Manage meets and events, prepare dive lists and start orders, and assign officials. The Control Room helps authorised officials follow the current diver and manage more than one event at a time. Each event has explicit device control and a clear takeover process.

JUDGE AT POOLSIDE
Open your assigned event and enter scores with a dedicated judging keypad. If you have more than one live assignment, choose the event before scoring.

FOLLOW THE COMPETITION
View live scores, standings and completed results. Divers and coaches can access the competition information and dive-list tools available to their account.

STAY INFORMED
Enable optional push notifications and manage notification preferences in Settings. Open supported DivingHQ links directly in the app.

BUILT FOR PHONES AND TABLETS
Use layouts that adapt to your device, with document sharing and printing where supported. Eligible pending submissions can be retained during a connection interruption and retried when connected. Live event control requires a connection; keep the app in the foreground while operating an event. Backgrounding stops automatic advancement.

Public results can be viewed without an account. Managing meets, judging and personal tools require a DivingHQ account and the appropriate organisation, event or role permissions. An internet connection is required for sign-in, current data and live competition updates.
releaseNotes: Choose between simultaneous judging assignments. Take control of each live event with explicit takeover between devices. Backgrounding stops automatic advancement, and returning requires taking control again. Includes notification preferences and layouts for phones and tablets.
